verdict: Creating bootable or prestaged media from the central administration site fails. The CAS cannot host an MP, and MECM now requires the SMS Provider to be co-located with an MP when building media.

evidence.match: Failed to get MP installation directory

fix: Build the media from a primary site instead of the CAS. Also confirm every SMS Provider in the hierarchy is co-located with an MP (this is a requirement introduced in 2409+). If the CAS is your only site today, the cleanest fix is to promote a primary; otherwise run the media builder from the primary `Administration -> Site Configuration -> Sites` context.
